Only the most carefully selected cuts of high-quality meats go into this dish.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowls are [[Meal]]s made by [[Cooking]] [[Raw Gourmet Meat]], [[Hylian Rice]], and [[Rock Salt]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. They can be eaten to restore several of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. The [[Meat]]s used in this dish are carefully selected to ensure their quality. Additional [[Ingredient]]s can be used when making Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowls, creating several different versions of the Meal. These versions are: * '''Chilly Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
Only the most carefully selected cuts of high-quality meats go into this dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding cold Ingredients. Eating them will grant Link a low-level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Only the most carefully selected cuts of high-quality meats go into this dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. If they are eaten, they grant link a low-level [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Only the most carefully selected cuts of high-quality meats go into this dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. They both refill and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel when consumed. * '''Energizing Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Only the most carefully selected cuts of high-quality meats go into this dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. If eaten, they will replenish a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Only the most carefully selected cuts of high-quality meats go into this dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. When eaten, they will grant Link a boost to his movement speed for a short time. * '''Hearty Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Only the most carefully selected cuts of high-quality meats go into this dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. Eating them will heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Mighty Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Only the most carefully selected cuts of high-quality meats go into this dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. Eating this Meal will temporarily boost the power of Link's attacks. * '''Sneaky Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Only the most carefully selected cuts of high-quality meats go into this dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. When eaten, they increase Link's [[Stealth]] temporarily. * '''Spicy Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
Only the most carefully selected cuts of high-quality meats go into this dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. They grant Link low-level [[Cold Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Tough Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowl}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Only the most carefully selected cuts of high-quality meats go into this dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients. They increase Link's defensive abilities if they are eaten. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Gourmet Meat and Rice Bowls return in {{TotK}}. Like in {{BotW}}, they can be made by [[Cooking]] [[Raw Gourmet Meat]], [[Hylian Rice]], and [[Rock Salt]] together. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Gourmet Cheesy Meat Bowl * Meal * Meat and Rice Bowl * Prime Meat and Rice Bowl }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
